feed.title: antxiko — commented disassemblies of 8-bit games
feed.subtitle: Old 8-bit binaries taken apart byte by byte and commented, with the tools to rebuild them: nothing gets claimed that the binary does not show, and the source has to give the original back, byte for byte. Right now that means 64 MSX games.

entry.title: Nemesis 2: the music, taken from its engine and checked against openMSX
entry.summary: 22 tunes of the cartridge, made by running its own sound engine frame by frame; the PSG writes match openMSX in every frame checked. It has the SCC chip too: its five wavetable channels are mixed with the PSG and checked against openMSX.
